title: Junta input batch splitting equivalence
statement: Let $n,R$ be natural numbers and let $P$ be a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$. The space of $R$-indexed batches of points in the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube is equivalent to the product of an $R$-indexed batch of sign assignments on $P$ and an $R$-indexed batch of sign assignments on the coordinates outside $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$
